name: Childbirth
overview: Scripture presents childbirth as a divinely ordained process, beginning with God's command to be fruitful and multiply (Genesis 1:28). However, due to the fall, childbirth is accompanied by sorrow and pain, as God declared to the woman in Genesis 3:16. This pain is likened to the travail of a woman nearing delivery, expressing both anguish and hope (Isaiah 26:17; John 16:21). The groaning of creation itself reflects the ongoing struggle and anticipation of redemption, symbolized through the pains of childbirth (Romans 8:22).
